example.el: Ξέχασα τη ρακέτα του τένις στο αυτοκίνητο.
example.en: I forgot my tennis racket in the car.

why: Example illustrated only the minor 'beach paddle ball' sense; replaced with first sense (racket).

example.el: Έχω μια παράκληση: μπορείς να μου κρατήσεις μια θέση;
example.en: I have a request: can you save me a seat?

why: Example illustrated only the church-service sense; replaced with first sense (request).

example.el: Φρεσκάραμε το σαλόνι με λίγη μπογιά.
example.en: We freshened up the living room with a bit of paint.

why: Example used the passive (φρεσκαριστώ), a separately listed sense; replaced with active first sense.

example.el: Η ανατροπή ενός φορτηγού προκάλεσε κυκλοφοριακό χάος στην εθνική οδό.
example.en: An overturned lorry caused traffic chaos on the motorway.

why: Example illustrated only the 'plot twist' sense; replaced with first sense (overturning).

example.en: The news took us all by surprise.

why: Missing disambiguating accent: μάς (pronoun object), not μας (possessive 'our news').

example.el: Φορούσε ένα δανεικό κοστούμι στον γάμο του φίλου του.
example.en: He wore a borrowed suit to his friend's wedding.

why: Example used the nominalised τα δανεικά (loan), a minor sense; replaced with adjectival first sense (borrowed).

example.el: Ο παππούς βγαίνει για λαγό με τα δύο λαγωνικά του.
example.en: Grandpa goes out after hare with his two hounds.

why: Example used the figurative sense (police sleuths); replaced with first sense (hunting dog).

example.el: Ο κυνηγός είχε το αγριογούρουνο στο στόχαστρο, αλλά δεν πυροβόλησε.
example.en: The hunter had the wild boar in his sights but didn't shoot.

why: Example used only the figurative 'targeted' sense; replaced with literal first sense (gunsight).

example.el: Η γιαγιά άφησε λουλούδια πάνω στην ταφόπλακα του παππού.
example.en: Grandma left flowers on Grandpa's gravestone.

why: Example used only the figurative 'final blow' sense; replaced with first sense (gravestone).
